تستهلكين (form X)
# تَسْتَهْلِكِينَ (tastahlikīna) /tas.tah.li.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# تُسْتَهْلَكِينَ (tustahlakīna) /tus.tah.la.kiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
